First day at the club

Hello! My name is Lila. I am twelve. My friend is Max. In our classroom there are six desks and twelve chairs. There is a blue board. There are two windows. Our teacher says, “Open your exercise books.” Max has a pencil, and I have a pen.

An email from Sami

Hi! I’m Sami and I’m eleven. I’m from Britain, and my friend Ana is from Spain. My sister, Noor, is thirteen. Our parents are teachers. My birthday is on Thursday. Noor’s birthday is on Sunday. This week Ana is at our house. She is very friendly.

Our animal club

Our school has an animal club on Wednesday. Ruby has got a white rabbit called Snow. Her brother Leo has got two green budgies. I have got a brown hamster called Pip. We have not got a snake. Our teacher, Mr Bell, has got a black dog. We draw our pets in Art and Design on Friday.

A busy Thursday

On Thursdays, Mina gets up at seven o’clock. She has breakfast at quarter past seven and walks to school at eight. Lessons start at half past eight. Mina has lunch at school. After school she has a violin lesson at quarter to five. She does her homework before dinner. Her brother plays football, but Mina does not play football.

A small town

There is a library next to the school in Elm Town. The café is opposite the school, across Green Road. There is a park behind the library. The town has a small museum, but there is not a cinema. At the sports centre you can swim and play tennis. You cannot play ice hockey there.

A Saturday message

It is Saturday morning. Usually, Theo plays tennis on Saturdays, but today it is raining. He is sitting in the living room and reading a book. His sister, Ivy, is wearing a green jumper and black jeans. She is drawing a picture. Their father has got short fair hair and glasses. He is making lunch in the kitchen.

James Hi, Anna.
Anna Oh, hello, James! How are you?
James I’m fine, thanks. And you?
Anna Fine, thanks.
James OK. See you later!
Anna Bye, see you!
